title: CONTRACT ENFORCEMENT: System Prompt + Provider Enum
summary: Implemented strict ProviderName type (7 values, no legacy fallbacks) + type guard function. Verified getSystemPrompt() has fallback to SYSTEM_PROMPTS.default. All 15 validation tests passing. Zero TypeScript errors. GATE_CONTRACT PASSED.
rationale: Legacy AIProviderName type had 19 variants including fallback aliases that could leak into error paths. System prompt already had proper fallback but needed validation tests. C1.1 ensures non-null system_prompt everywhere. C1.2 ensures provider is always known, never undefined.
notes: AIProviderName kept for backward compatibility (marked @deprecated). No code changes required but migration to ProviderName recommended for new code.

title: UI ANTI-SILENCE: MessageBubble never frozen/silent
contract: UI always shows spinner/error/content, never silent
summary: Implemented 17 validation tests proving MessageBubble never goes silent (empty, frozen). Tests cover: typing indicator (pending), error fallback (old response), content rendering (success), user messages, system messages, accessibility (aria-labels, roles). GATE_UI PASSED.
rationale: User experience depends on visual feedback. Silent UI (empty bubble with no spinner/error/message) creates perception of frozen app. MessageBubble already had anti-silence logic; C2 validates it via comprehensive test suite.
notes: No code changes. Tests only. MessageBubble component already implements correct anti-silence logic (TypingIndicator for pending, ChatFallback for error, content for success). C2 purely validates this.
